bullets: Researched faster sampling algorithms for diffusion language models with the DiffusionGemma team, improving inference efficiency over state-of-the-art baselines.
Designed and built an end-to-end evaluation harness covering generation, scoring, sandboxed code evaluation, LLM autoraters, sampling trace analysis, and results visualization.
Developed a new sampling method with substantial efficiency gains; publication pending and details under embargo.
Conducted research in probabilistic machine learning spanning diffusion models, discrete MCMC methods, and variational inference for large language models.
Built large-scale experimental pipelines using PyTorch, PyTorch Lightning, Hydra, and Slurm for training and evaluating language and generative models.
